declarations.description: `<pds-top-app-bar>`: the header at the top of a screen.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: short and short-with-sub are a fixed 64px; long is 96px and can grow further for a longer headline.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The headline text. Renders as the default slot's fallback content; slotted markup takes over instead.

attributes.name: subtitle
attributes.description: Second line of text; only shown while `variant="short-with-sub"`.

attributes.name: scrolled
attributes.description: Applies an on-scroll tint. This component has no scroll listener of its own; toggle this yourself.

declarations.name: PdsPreview
declarations.description: `<pds-preview>`: the reviewer's frame around a generated screen. Not an app component and not exported from index.js: a phone-sized card with 48px corners and, above it and outside the screen, toggles for light/dark, rounded/square corners and language (EN, zh-Hans, ja).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Theme to preview. Mirrored onto data-theme on the <html> element so tokens/tokens.css switches.

attributes.name: corners
attributes.description: Frame corners: 48px radius, or none.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Frame width in CSS px.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Frame minimum height in CSS px; the frame grows with its content.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Copy language to preview: English, modern Chinese (Simplified, zh-Hans) or Japanese. Sets lang on <html> and swaps copy declared with data-zh/data-ja (text) or data-<attr>-zh/data-<attr>-ja (attributes).
